title: Trump gets new path to challenge 34-count conviction; state appeal on hold
description: In a surprising turn of events, Donald Trump’s legal team has been afforded a fresh opportunity to challenge his criminal conviction. A federal appeals court has chosen to revisit his application to shift jurisdiction from New York. This could pave the way for Trump to assert presidential immunity, potentially leading to an overturn of his conviction.

£1.9m Tamworth Castle restoration reveals 1960s cigarette pack, old newspaper
description: The £1.9 million restoration of Tamworth Castle is revealing intriguing historical artifacts. Among the recent discoveries are a cigarette packet from the 1950s and a 1968 newspaper, shedding light on the lives of its past inhabitants. Additionally, restorers found an 18th or 19th-century lead-lined sink, enhancing our understanding of the castle's historical usage.

title: Kenyan ex-radio host helps topi numbers rise from 33 to 300+, wins Tusk award
description: Raabia Hawa has been honored with the 2026 Tusk Award for her exceptional dedication to wildlife conservation. As a former radio personality, she pivoted her career to enhance efforts in protecting endangered species in Kenya. Through her founded Ulinzi Africa Foundation, she has championed anti-poaching campaigns, directly aiding in the resurgence of coastal topi populations, and emphasizing the essential role of community engagement in conservation success.

title: 'Back door for low-skilled migrants': Reform UK pledges to scrap graduate visa route
description: Reform UK has announced plans to abolish graduate visas, citing concerns about low-skilled migration. These visas allow international students to work in the UK for two years after completing their degrees. Additionally, the party aims to introduce stricter rules for international students seeking to remain in the country. Reform UK has received criticism for targeting international students, particularly those from India.

title: Taj Mahal marble slab taken by East India Company officer to be auctioned in London
description: A remarkable piece of history, a marble slab from the iconic Taj Mahal, is scheduled to be auctioned on December 9 in the UK. This exquisite slab was taken over 200 years ago by Colonel Pownoll Phipps during the British Raj and was recently uncovered during restoration works. Adorned with delicate carvings and semi-precious stones, it mirrors the floral motifs found on Shah Jahan's cenotaph.

title: UK net migration tumbles by 92%; Indians still most common nationality to immigrate
description: Long-term international net migration to the UK has seen a sharp decline, reducing to 77,000 for the year ending June 2026, a staggering drop of 92% from the previous peak of 944,000. This reduction is mainly attributed to changes in visa policies that have impacted non-EU immigration, alongside fewer asylum seekers this year. Notably, Indian immigrants accounted for the largest demographics involved in both immigration and emigration.

title: Guiding light
Ex-terrorist fugitive’s 19-year run ends in arrest
description: Mohammad Mansha, a former terrorist, was arrested by a joint police team in Tral. He had evaded law enforcement for nearly two decades since laying down arms in 2007. Authorities revealed he was wanted in at least 13 criminal cases, including murder and conspiracy. His criminal activities included the killing of a police officer back in 2000. The operation involved meticulous planning and credible intelligence from various police units.

description: The ongoing debate about heavy machinery's presence near Sheshnag Lake along the Amarnath Yatra route is drawing intense scrutiny. Karan Singh pointed out that not all pilgrimage paths necessitate vehicle accessibility for pilgrims. Meanwhile, Mehbooba Mufti demanded transparency and public disclosure of any agreements linked to construction efforts. The J&K government refuted claims about construction, insisting that machinery is operating at a considerable distance.

description: Germany's commitment to technology transfer under the P-75I submarine project with India is being emphasized. This partnership aims to enhance India's capabilities in undersea warfare technology, including Air-Independent Propulsion. Both nations share mutual trust regarding the protection of sensitive technologies and strategic interests in the Indo-Pacific region. The deal may also lead India to become a hub for submarine manufacturing for Southeast Asian nations.

description: A religious dispute over the national song Vande Mataram has intensified among clerics in Kashmir. Sunni scholar Maulana Abdul Rashid Dawoodi urged for a fatwa regarding standing during its rendition. Meanwhile, grand mufti Nasir-ul-Islam declared participation as impermissible under Islamic law. Several clerics expressed regret after attending a function where Vande Mataram was played. The controversy stems from a recent Union home ministry directive mandating its performance at official events.

description: Thirty terrorists from Reasi district crossed over to Pakistan and Pakistan-occupied Kashmir between 1991 and 2003. They obtained training and arms to launch activities against India while disrupting peace in Jammu and Kashmir. These individuals are now associated with Hizbul Mujahideen, facilitating the supply of arms and funds. Police have registered an FIR against them under various laws, including the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act.

title: I’m no troublemaker, won’t sign peace bond: Wangchuk
description: Sonam Wangchuk, representing the Leh Apex Body, was called upon by the district administration to discuss a peace bond. While he attended the meeting, Wangchuk declined to endorse any bond, deeming it unnecessary. He was given one week to address an extensive notice filled with allegations; however, his attorney later received a demand for a quicker response by November 28, prompting concerns about administrative transparency.

Road min tightens bidding norms to keep poor performers out of govt projects
description: The road transport ministry has updated the bidding process for contractors to ensure better project execution. Performance ratings will now determine contractors’ eligibility for new projects, replacing the old financial year assessment approach. Stricter norms for joint ventures and improved technical eligibility conditions for major infrastructure projects have also been implemented. The revised Request for Proposal framework emphasizes transparency by requiring bidders to disclose ongoing disputes.

description: The CM highlighted the government’s achievements across various sectors, including education, healthcare, employment, women’s empowerment, farmers’ welfare, tourism, industry, investment, infrastructure and good governance.

title: Essex treasure hunter finds rare 380-year-old square coin he may not get to keep
description: Discoveries like this don't happen every day! A metal detector enthusiast in Essex came across a remarkable silver coin, dating to 1646, in a farmer's field. Dubbed a siege piece from the English Civil War that spanned 1642 to 1651, the coin bears the initials of King Charles I, suggesting a Royalist connection.

Sri Lanka A crush India A's Asia Cup Rising Stars dream with stunning chase
description: Sri Lanka A delivered a remarkable performance against India A in the semifinal of the Asia Cup Rising Stars. Successfully chasing down a formidable target of 318 runs, Sri Lanka A claimed victory by eight wickets with 9.3 overs to spare. Sineth Jayawardena and Lasith Croospulle both achieved centuries, setting a solid base for the chase.

title: Centre may amend defeated women's reservation Bill ahead of spl Parl sitting: Report
description: The Union Cabinet will meet to discuss the delimitation-linked women's reservation Bill proposed by the government. This Bill aims to provide 33 percent reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and state assemblies. The Constitution amendment aims to increase Lok Sabha seats from 543 to 850, linking it to delimitation. Congress has criticized the government for attempting to revive a previously defeated Bill during a special session.

title: 'Torture with legal cover': Report exposes Israel's abuse of Palestinian prisoners
description: A report has revealed that Israel's security agency, Shin Bet, has allegedly used torture during interrogations. Within a study of 42 complaints, over three-quarters reported torture leading to confessions. Various abusive interrogation methods include sleep deprivation and physical assault against Palestinian detainees. The findings raise concerns about the effectiveness of investigations into such allegations and the justice mechanism's accountability.

title: India, UAE to fast-track joint development, production of next-gen defence equipment
Hundreds of flights cancelled as storm disrupts US on Thanksgiving
Jaydev Unadkat scripts history with stunning No. 11 knock, smashes T20 world record
description: In an extraordinary display of resilience, Jaydev Unadkat smashed 40 runs while batting at No. 11 in a T20 match, setting a new record that eclipsed the former high of 35 runs. His partnership with Chetan Sakariya yielded an impressive 62 runs for the 10th wicket. Unfortunately, their valiant effort was not enough, as Saurashtra fell to Tamil Nadu by 38 runs, thus eliminating their Super League aspirations.

title: Mamdani's rent freeze that made Google founder exit NY real estate gets judge's nod
description: A New York City court upheld Mayor Zohran Mamdani's controversial rent freeze for one million rent-stabilised apartments. The ruling supports tenants facing high living costs in the city, indicating a victory for affordability. Judge Brendan Lantry dismissed claims from landlords challenging the Rent Guidelines Board's process for implementing the freeze. Mayor Mamdani emphasized the necessity of affordable housing for working New Yorkers amid rising expenses.

title: India's answer to drone swarms? Bhargavastra clears key trials
description: The Bhargavastra system, created by Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited, has successfully passed its trials at the Pokhran firing ranges in Rajasthan. This innovative defense technology was evaluated for its ability to detect and neutralize swarm-drone targets with air defense rockets and micro-missiles. The recent trials showcased effective engagement with real drone targets, highlighting guidance and tracking capabilities.

title: How Pentagon considered using Cold War law to bring Jensen Huang back
‘105 days of Op Lotus’: Oppn slams Centre over spl Parl sitting amid delimitation bill buzz
description: Opposition leaders have condemned the government's initiative to convene a special sitting of Parliament on November 30. They allege that this move aims to secure the necessary numbers for the delimitation-linked Constitution amendment Bill. Various opposition parties have expressed concerns about the implications for parliamentary democracy. The Congress and CPI(M) particularly highlight the government’s motives behind this political maneuvering.

title: 'Wish Akhilesh spent 6 months in jail': Azam Khan quips; gets witty reply from SP chief
description: Azam Khan openly wished that Akhilesh Yadav would spend time in prison to truly grasp its harsh realities. During the launch of the SP manifesto for the upcoming elections, Khan shared his emotional turmoil over being distanced from his son and the sleepless nights spent worrying about his son's fate amid transfers.

title: Britain calls up military reservists for first time since Cold War amid Russia threat
description: In an effort to bolster national security, Britain is contacting 100,000 military reservists. The Ministry of Defence is keen to define their roles and evaluate the skills of former servicemen and women. This initiative is largely a response to the shifting security landscape in Europe due to Russia's aggression in Ukraine.

title: CM Yogi accuses oppn of weakening Constitution, misleading people with ‘red book’
description: Yogi Adityanath addressed a Constitution Day programme in Lucknow, criticizing opposition parties for weakening democratic institutions. He specifically accused the Congress of disrespecting Dr. BR Ambedkar and undermining the Constitution. Adityanath announced beautification projects at nearly 4,000 Ambedkar sites as part of a development scheme. Furthermore, he highlighted the importance of voting rights granted to all citizens since the Constitution's enforcement.

title: Baler isn’t a bailout: Why stubble subsidies still bypass small farmers
description: Stubble burning has sharply declined in Punjab and Haryana due to Government interventions, yet many farmers still burn residue. The critical 10-day window between crops often leads to hasty decisions among farmers without access to machinery. While some farmers benefit from private baling businesses and government subsidies, others face structural barriers to accessing these services. Issues include machinery availability, high costs, and delays in subsidies affecting smallholders disproportionately.

title: China says situation along India border ‘generally stable’, reiterates claim over Arunachal
description: China's military reported that the situation along the India-China border is currently stable and communication is ongoing. High-level military talks addressed recent troop build-up concerns in Arunachal Pradesh, particularly in the Upper Subansiri region. China reasserted its claim over the Arunachal Pradesh territory, calling it Zangnan, despite India's opposition. Simultaneously, concerns were raised regarding India-Japan defense cooperation, which China criticized.

title: Jensen Huang and wife’s foundation gains $2.3B in a day, they have donated $425M
description: The reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO has propelled Lori Huang's foundation to new heights, elevating its value to an impressive $9.7 billion, fueled by significant gains in Nvidia's stock. The foundation's philanthropic endeavors have included noteworthy contributions to institutions like Vanderbilt University, positioning charitable giving as a means for strategic investment in future tech innovations. Despite this success, it maintains a low profile in public awareness.

title: 'Grandmaster of politics': Trump's son-in-law hails Putin's nuclear restraint
description: Jared Kushner praised Vladimir Putin for his adept political maneuvers and demonstrated restraint amid the escalating Ukraine conflict. He advocated for focusing negotiation efforts on sustainable peace rather than merely territorial issues. Kushner underscored the importance of reliable US security assurances for Ukraine's sovereignty while backing its aspirations for closer integration with Europe, including potential EU membership.

title: What is EPFO Amnesty Scheme 2026? Importance and significance for legacy PF trusts
description: Over the years, several establishments formed independent PF trust to administer benefits for their employees. In many instances, these trusts obtained recognition under the Income-tax Act, 1961 and operated as employer-managed. However, recognition under Income tax law and exemption under PF law are two different statutory requirements. Compliance with one framework does not automatically satisfy the requirements of the other.

title: Meta vs Congress: Why opposition party is up in arms against the tech giant
description: Congress has taken legal action against Meta and the Indian government by filing a petition in the Delhi high court. They assert that the automated system for blocking content is hindering the dissemination of legitimate political messages relating to Rahul Gandhi, including innocent birthday wishes and tributes. This, they argue, threatens transparent communication with voters prior to the forthcoming elections. The high court is set to commence hearings soon.

title: 'No regrets': Shami opens up on Test retirement, says he's happy with what he received
description: Mohammed Shami concluded his involvement in the Syed Mushtaq Ali T20 Trophy, taking four wickets in seven matches. Although he recently retired from Test cricket, he plans to remain active in white-ball formats and domestic play. Shami expressed pride in nurturing young talent and echoed Shubman Gill's call for allowing bowlers to use saliva. He also advocated for afternoon starts in T20s to minimise dew's effect on the pitch.

title: Govt calls for special Parliament session from Monday amid delimitation bill buzz
description: The government has scheduled special parliamentary sessions to address essential business starting November 30, 2026. Discussions will include the government's plans for delimitation and women's reservation. The Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill had previously failed to secure the required majority in Lok Sabha. There are growing concerns among opposition parties regarding the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Ministers have been asked to prepare for these upcoming parliamentary discussions and debates.

title: 'All the way': Sindhu eyes maiden Uber Cup title as India gets 2028 hosting rights
description: PV Sindhu is determined to guide India's badminton team to victory at the 2028 Uber Cup Finals, marking the nation's return as a host after 14 years since 2014. The tournament will introduce an exciting 24-team format, fostering greater competition and camaraderie among teams. Sindhu aims to motivate young athletes in their quest for national representation, reflecting the impressive growth and success of Indian badminton on the global stage.

title: PDA quota, dole for jobless, pensions: Decoding Akhilesh's big UP manifesto promises
description: Akhilesh Yadav has unveiled an ambitious manifesto for the upcoming 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections, focusing on creating 25 lakh government jobs and providing Rs 5,000 monthly assistance for unemployed graduates. The manifesto champions caste representation and women's safety while fostering a diverse coalition. Additional proposals include waiving farmers' loans and investing substantially in rural infrastructure, particularly targeting the youth and various communities in Uttar Pradesh.

title: Patrick Mahomes enjoys family time with Brittany and children ahead of Bills showdown
description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes take out time for their children ahead of the clash against Buffalo Bills.

title: Watch: Traffic cop dragged 50 feet on SUV bonnet after driver tries to evade challan
description: On Wednesday evening in Baramati, a constable attempted to stop a speeding SUV for traffic violations. The driver, Dheeraj Shedge, accelerated towards the officer, who clung to the vehicle's bonnet for nearly fifty feet. The constable suffered serious injuries to his left arm and leg during the incident. Police managed to apprehend Shedge within four hours of the incident in Satara district.

title: 'CM will have a moustache': Owaisi takes 'clean-shaven face, head' dig at Yogi, Akhilesh
Why old ammunition can become a ticking time bomb: The science behind controlled explosions
description: A controlled detonation of nearly five tonnes of lead azide was carried out successfully in Iowa. This explosive compound had deteriorated and posed risks to public safety over the years. Residents expressed concerns about potential health and environmental hazards from the planned blast. The US Army confirmed that the risks had been reduced to near zero after the operation.

title: Hands-off mastermind: Behind Delhi coconut stall, a burglary ring exploiting teens
description: Rakesh, a 48-year-old street vendor in Dwarka, reportedly led a burglary scheme using local teenagers. He scouted locked homes and shops, passing tips to minors for nighttime thefts. The police arrested him after a burglary at a garment showroom revealed the involvement of two juveniles. Rakesh's careful strategy avoided direct participation to elude legal consequences. He has prior theft offenses and is now being questioned about recent burglaries.

title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes foundation received $1.7 million from 28 funders
description: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ 15 and the Mahomies received over a million from over 25 funders for their foundation between 2019 and 2025. Kansas City Chiefs owner Clark Hunt’s foundation and the league foundation are some of the funders who believe in Chiefs ace quarterback Patrick Mahomes’ vision for underserved children.
